subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards remain full-content-only with better pacing, or should OpenClaw add a documented opt-in append/delta mode for deployments where full-content CardKit updates are too slow?
rationale: Current source confirms the full-content path, and a fresh live repro says pacing alone did not fix the long-tail latency, but append mode conflicts with Feishu's documented full-text contract and would add config surface.

options.title: Add Validated Opt-In Append Mode
options.body: Keep the documented full-content behavior as the default, add an explicit append/delta mode only for affected deployments, and require docs, compatibility tests, and live proof before landing.

options.title: Keep Full-Content Only
options.body: Reject append mode and continue pursuing cadence, print_strategy, or transport optimizations that preserve Feishu's documented full-content contract.

options.title: Disable Streaming For Affected Setups
options.body: Document streaming:false or raw render mode as the supported workaround while leaving the current CardKit behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Add Validated Opt-In Append Mode
recommendation.body: Keep the documented full-content behavior as the default, add an explicit append/delta mode only for affected deployments, and require docs, compatibility tests, and live proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu plugin maintainer, and the decision is Feishu-channel-specific.
